mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 76 degrees at the Verona Area High School, with a beautiful full moon tonight.
The city is preparing for the November election, with early voting available at City Hall, and the Plan Commission will review several development proposals on September 8.

Today, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, a visit to the downtown Farmer's Market, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, catch more trivia at Hop Haus.
On August 17, the Verona Police Department successfully located and arrested a 21-year-old man on Cross Country Road for a probation violation.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. The store is currently open until 10:00 PM, so stop by and enjoy a scoop.
